_doc: KILL SWITCH for the multichain tip (frontend/public/tip.mjs). enabled:false stops every tip; mainnetLive:false leaves only testnets (the legacy key `mainnet` stays false on purpose: page code cached from before 9 Nov 13:30Z only reads that key, so it can never send real money). Fail closed: if this file can't be read, tips are off. Edit on gh-pages + push: the page re-reads it (cache-busted) before every review and every transfer; GitHub Pages' CDN may serve the old file for up to ~10 minutes.
